info.title: Pishkhan Admin API
info.description: Contract owned by the backend (overview section 6). Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details whose `errors` hold message keys.

post.summary: Staff sign-in with password and TOTP
post.description: On first sign-in returns status totp_enrollment_required with a TOTP secret; confirm it with /auth/totp/enroll.

post.summary: Confirm TOTP enrollment and start the session
Rotate the staff refresh token (15-minute idle, 8-hour absolute)
End the staff session
Re-authenticate for a dangerous action; returns a 5-minute token

get.summary: Current staff member
Staff accounts

post.summary: Create a staff account (step-up required)
Start a support session in a workspace (Support, step-up, reason required)
post.description: Returns a one-time link to the user panel, valid 2 minutes. The panel exchanges it for a 30-minute session as the member (the owner unless `userId` is given) with the staff member recorded on every change. The owner sees the reason in their audit log.

example.reason: تیکت ۱۲۴۵: قانون پاسخ خودکار کار نمی‌کند

post.summary: Deactivate a staff account and end its sessions
post.description: SuperAdmin, step-up, reason. 409 `backoffice.staff.self` for your own account, `backoffice.staff.last_super_admin` for the last active SuperAdmin.

post.summary: Reactivate a staff account (also clears a lockout)
post.description: SuperAdmin, step-up, reason.

post.summary: Clear a staff member's TOTP so the next sign-in enrolls again, and end their sessions
post.description: SuperAdmin, step-up, reason. 409 `backoffice.staff.self` for your own account.

put.summary: Replace a staff member's roles and end their sessions so the new roles apply
put.description: SuperAdmin, step-up, reason. 409 `backoffice.staff.last_super_admin` when it would leave no active SuperAdmin.

get.summary: The current staff member's active sessions

delete.summary: End one of your own sessions

get.summary: Health of every dependency: PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka (with lag), object storage, ClamAV (with signature age), workers, Instagram, AI
get.description: Every staff role. Same shape as /health/ready, with a detail per check. Checks run in parallel with a 5 second limit each.

get.summary: Home dashboard KPIs and alerts
get.description: Every staff role. "Today" is the Tehran calendar day.

get.summary: Kafka topics, retained messages and consumer group lag
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support, AIOps, ReadOnly. Read from the brokers, cached 15 seconds. 503 `platform.kafka_unavailable` when the brokers do not answer.

get.summary: Dead letters, newest first
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support, AIOps, ReadOnly. Without the payload.

get.summary: Open dead letters per consumer group
Worker replicas, recurring jobs and worker groups
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support, AIOps, ReadOnly. Replicas and jobs come from the Quartz cluster tables; groups from Kafka (empty when the brokers do not answer).

get.summary: A dead letter with its envelope and payload
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support (the payload may hold customer messages).

post.summary: Replay open dead letters to the consumer that failed them
post.description: SuperAdmin, step-up. Each goes back to its topic with a new message id, handled only by the consumer that failed it. Audited as platform.dead_letter_replay.

post.summary: Discard open dead letters
post.description: SuperAdmin, step-up. The message is not processed; the row stays for the record. Audited as platform.dead_letter_discard.

post.summary: Run a recurring job now
post.description: SuperAdmin, step-up. A replica picks it up within about 30 seconds; the schedule continues afterwards. 409 `platform.job_busy` unless the job is waiting. Audited as platform.job_trigger.

get.summary: Feature flags
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support, AIOps, Finance, ReadOnly.

post.summary: Create a flag
post.description: SuperAdmin. 409 `backoffice.flag_exists`. Audited as feature_flag.create.

get.summary: Every flag as it applies to a workspace, with its override

put.description: SuperAdmin. Reaches every host within 30 seconds. Audited as feature_flag.update.

post.summary: Delete a flag and its overrides
post.description: SuperAdmin, step-up. Audited as feature_flag.delete.

put.summary: Turn a flag on or off for one workspace, or remove the override
put.description: Support or SuperAdmin. Audited as feature_flag.override in the workspace's log.

get.summary: CMS entries, most recently edited first

post.summary: Create an entry (a draft)
post.description: 409 `content.slug_taken` when the kind already has the slug. Posts and help articles need an existing `category` of their kind.

get.summary: One entry with its draft

put.summary: Save the draft (the website keeps showing the published copy)
put.description: 409 `content.stale` when `revision` is not the current one; 409 `content.slug_locked` when changing the slug of an entry that was published (add a redirect and a new entry instead).

delete.summary: Delete an entry that was never published

get.summary: Blog and help categories, in display order

post.summary: Add a blog or help category

get.summary: Website redirects

post.summary: Add a redirect
post.description: 409 `content.redirect_exists` when `from` already redirects.

post.summary: Publish the draft now, or schedule it with `at`
post.description: 409 `content.consent_required` for a case study without `data.consent: true`; 409 `content.category_required`. The website refreshes within a minute.

post.summary: Take an entry off the website (publish it again to restore it)
A preview token for the draft, valid one hour

put.summary: Rename or reorder a category (the slug is fixed)

delete.summary: Delete a category no entry uses

get.summary: Website leads, newest first (SuperAdmin, Support)
Search the audit log, newest first
get.description: SuperAdmin sees every entry; Support sees only entries of a workspace. Before/after snapshots have secrets redacted.

get.summary: Search workspaces, newest first
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support, Finance, ReadOnly. Owner phones are masked; each row carries its channels' status.

get.summary: A workspace with its owner, members and channels
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support, Finance, ReadOnly. Deleted workspaces are still found (their data is gone).

get.summary: Search panel users, newest first
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support, Finance, ReadOnly. Phones are masked; search by a full phone number to find one user.

get.summary: A user with their workspaces and signed-in devices

post.summary: Sign the user out on every device
post.description: Support or SuperAdmin, step-up. Access tokens stop working at once; audited as user.sessions_revoke.

post.summary: Block the user: no sign-in, every session ends
post.description: Support or SuperAdmin, step-up. Their workspaces stay as they are; audited as user.block.

post.summary: Let a blocked user sign in again
post.description: Support or SuperAdmin, step-up. Audited as user.unblock.

get.summary: Plan versions, in display order, newest version first
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Finance, Support, ReadOnly. Filter by `code` or `status` (draft, published, archived).

post.summary: Create a plan (version 1, draft)
post.description: Finance or SuperAdmin. 409 `billing.plan.code_taken` when the code exists. Audited as plan.create.

get.summary: One plan version

put.description: Finance or SuperAdmin. Published and archived versions are fixed (409 `billing.plan.not_draft`): start a new version instead.

post.summary: Start a new draft version from this one
post.description: Finance or SuperAdmin. 409 `billing.plan.draft_exists` when the plan already has a draft.

post.summary: Publish a draft; the plan's previous published version is archived
post.description: Finance or SuperAdmin, step-up. Subscriptions keep the version they are on until renewal. The public price list updates within a minute.

post.summary: Withdraw a version from sale
post.description: Finance or SuperAdmin, step-up, `reason` required. Archiving the published version takes the plan off the price list.

get.summary: A workspace's plan, usage this period and subscription history
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Finance, Support, ReadOnly. History is newest first.

post.summary: Grant a plan or a trial
post.description: Finance or SuperAdmin, step-up. `planId` is a published version. Replaces the current subscription; audited in the workspace as subscription.grant.

post.summary: Extend the current subscription or trial
post.description: Finance or SuperAdmin, step-up. 409 `billing.subscription.none` without a subscription, `billing.subscription.not_extendable` when it has no end. Audited as subscription.extend.

post.summary: End the current subscription now; the workspace returns to the free plan
post.description: Finance or SuperAdmin, step-up. Audited as subscription.cancel.

get.summary: AI providers in effect
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, AIOps, ReadOnly. Keys are never returned.

get.summary: Model routes per task
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, AIOps, ReadOnly. Every task, with its fallback chain in effect.

get.summary: Prompt keys with their active version
Every version of a prompt, newest first, with its latest eval run
Eval sets with their case counts
Eval runs, newest first

post.summary: Start an eval run
post.description: AIOps or SuperAdmin. Runs in the background (202); poll the run. Only `intent.classify` is evaluated for now.

get.summary: A run with its per-case results (failures first)

put.description: AIOps or SuperAdmin. Up to 5 steps over providers in effect; an empty list falls back to configuration. Audited as ai.routes.update.

post.summary: Write a new version
post.description: AIOps or SuperAdmin. Numbered after the highest existing version; not active until it passes the eval gate. Audited as ai.prompt.create.

post.summary: Activate a version through the eval gate
post.description: AIOps or SuperAdmin. 409 `ai.prompt.eval_gate` (with the gate in `errors`) unless the run is a completed run of this version that passes every check. Audited as ai.prompt.activate.

post.summary: Import or update cases from JSON Lines
post.description: AIOps or SuperAdmin. Body: UTF-8 JSON Lines (`application/x-ndjson` or `text/plain`), one anonymized case per line; a known `ref` updates its case. Creates the set when new.

put.description: SuperAdmin, step-up. Takes effect on every host within the refresh interval; audited as ai.provider.update.

post.summary: Send one tiny request through a provider
post.description: SuperAdmin. The provider as it is in effect now; the result is kept on a back-office provider.

get.summary: AI traces across workspaces, newest first, without customer content
Trace counts by outcome over the last `hours` (default 24, at most 720)
One trace, redacted

post.summary: One trace with customer content
post.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, AIOps, Support. Reason of 5 to 300 characters; audited as ai.trace.reveal in the workspace's audit log.

get.summary: Industry template versions

post.summary: Create the first draft for an industry without a template

get.summary: One template version

put.summary: Edit a draft; issues are returned, not rejected

post.summary: Start a new draft from this version
Publish a draft; the industry's published version is archived
Archive a version; an archived published version leaves the industry without a template

get.summary: The Instagram outage status and the detector's counts

put.summary: Set the outage mode: let the detector decide, or declare Instagram down or up

get.summary: Files in quarantine, newest first
get.description: Roles: SuperAdmin, Support. Infected, scan_failed and pending files older than 10 minutes unless `status` says otherwise.

get.summary: How many files sit in each quarantine state

post.summary: Scan the file again
post.description: Support or SuperAdmin. Infected, scan_failed and pending files; the file is pending until the scan ends. Audited as file.rescan.

post.summary: Delete a quarantined file now
post.description: Support or SuperAdmin, step-up. Removes the stored objects and the row; clean files cannot be deleted here. Audited as file.delete.

post.summary: Mark an infected verdict as a false positive
post.description: SuperAdmin, step-up. The file is scanned again without reusing earlier verdicts; it is served only if that scan is clean. Audited as file.false_positive.
